terra.problem: The line and “Jacob’s sons are born” imply that all twelve sons were born in Paddan-aram. Genesis 35:26 summarizes the list that way, but Genesis 35:16-18 places Benjamin’s birth near Ephrath, after Jacob returned. The passage in the moment lists the sons rather than describing their births.
“Isaac marries Rebekah” describes a marriage in Canaan, not an event in Paddan-aram (Genesis 24:62-67). Rebekah’s family was from Paddan-aram.
“Jacob is sent to find a wife” takes place before Jacob travels to Paddan-aram, not in the region itself (Genesis 28:10).
“God blesses Jacob again” takes place at Bethel after Jacob returned from Paddan-aram, not in Paddan-aram (Genesis 35:9, 15).
